capability: Sort a tangled code map into four readable floors
title: Rules on top, parts below.

hook.picture: Close on the whale dumping every file card onto the line, links everywhere, until it is a tangled knot. A pod walks in and spins.
hook.words: We mapped every file. All of it.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: We mapped the whole codebase, and nobody can read it.

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Three more crates tip in, every 2 beats, then 1, then a half. The knot thickens each time.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: Everything sits at the same level.

stakes.body: New people and new agents can't find their way, so they guess, and the guesses become bugs.

solution_hint: Put the rules first. Then the parts.

metaphor.body: The rule cards go on top, pinned. Then the big parts, then what users touch, then what is named as next. Links run only between rows where the docs show them.

steps.picture: The whale pulls three rule cards out of the knot, up to the top shelf, and pins them.
steps.words: Rules first, pinned at the top.

steps.picture: Next shelf: six big part cards. Then a shelf of smaller cards users touch. Then a shelf of flagged 'next' cards.
steps.words: Then parts, then what users touch, then next.

steps.picture: Push-in. Links redraw only between shelves where the docs show them; hundreds of threads collapse into a few clear ones.
steps.sound: A long exhale of strings into one chord.

steps.picture: Four clean rows, top to bottom, the pins holding the rules in place.
steps.words: Four rows that anyone can read.
steps.sound: Four clacks, then a held chord.

real_case.claim: The OAH review replaced the 225KB raw ingest (a folder walk, cap 400, that hairballs in 3D) with a digest in four strata: L0 law, L1 packages, L2 surfaces, L3 named next.

honest_limit.picture: The whale drops a card on the wrong shelf. It sits there, and no pin, gate or chip reacts.
honest_limit.words: Wrong row? Nothing in the map objects.

not_this.body: A tidy map, not a checked one.

ending_pattern.body: The same crate tips, but every card drops onto its shelf as it lands, and the pod walks straight through, row by row.
ending_pattern.callback: The knot that trapped the pod in bar 2 never forms; the same tipping gesture now fills four shelves.

end_belief.body: Sort your map into rows before sharing.
